title: First environment audit
body:
## Goal
Measure the loop environment and write the first audit report to `audit/latest.md`.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `audit/latest.md` exists and states the measured environment facts with evidence paths
- [ ] No managed definitions are changed
## Verification
`test -f audit/latest.md`
## Context
- link: policy/roles/audit/SKILL.md - the audit role's work rules
- link: policy/working-memory.md - no iteration has been considered yet, so this is the first audit
## Budget
- policy/ and execution/ read-only; no iteration records exist yet

title: Write src/greeting.txt
body:
## Goal
Create the file `src/greeting.txt` containing the single line `hello from perpetua`. Create nothing else. Report, do not add other files.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` exists and its only line is `hello from perpetua`
- [ ] no other file is created or changed
## Verification
`test "$(cat src/greeting.txt)" = "hello from perpetua"`
## Context
- goal: `.session/loop-state.json` field `goal.text`, the full goal for this iteration
## Budget
- `src/greeting.txt` (new file, the only file to write)
